title: Demonic Path's Hidden Piece
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji was weighing the pros and cons, a violent spiritual energy fluctuation came from the direction of Tianqing Sect—someone was forcefully breaking through the sect's mountain protection formation.

text.content: Chen Ling's body grew increasingly transparent, as if being pulled apart from within by an invisible force. The corner of her lips curved slightly upward, and in a voice only Chen Ji could hear, she said, "Brother, wait for me to find her." Before her words even faded, her entire form dissolved into the air like morning mist, leaving only a jade slip imbued with her aura resting quietly in Chen Ji's palm.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji gripped the jade slip, his knuckles white from the force. His expression remained as calm as ever, as if he hadn't just lost his own sister, but merely a stone by the roadside. Yet his left hand secretly clenched within his sleeve—that was the instinct of someone who bore grudges but never acted rashly.

text.content: Just then, a sinister laughter rang out from the depths of the void. "Young friend Chen, your sister was quite decisive, erasing her soul mark herself." The voice carried a playful tone. "It's just a pity about that 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key' identity. This Saint spent three hundred years finding a replacement."

dialogue.content: Ye Qing's face turned deathly pale. How could someone from the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path track them here? She hastily activated the 'Demonic Path Mist' to conceal Chen Ji's aura, only to find that the voice's owner had already locked onto this location. "S-Saint... Elder of the Holy Sect? Why would you be here?"

text.content: From the void, a black-robed figure slowly materialized. The figure was tall yet hunched over, his face hidden beneath a hood, revealing only a pair of eerie green eyes. He fiddled with a skull令牌 in his hand, and with each rotation, the surrounding air grew colder by a degree.

dialogue.content: "This one is the Commander of the Demonic Path, codename 'Gui Xu'." The black-robed figure slightly raised his head, his emerald pupils fixed directly on Chen Ji. "The Tianji Record's inheritor is indeed extraordinary. Your sister destroyed her own soul, yet you didn't even furrow your brow—such composure qualifies you for cooperation with me."

text.content: Chen Ji tucked the jade slip into his sleeve and lifted his gaze to the Demonic Path Commander. His voice was calm as water: "Cooperation? We've never met, and the Demonic Path Commander extends an olive branch right off the bat. Aren't you afraid I'll bite off more than I can chew?" His tone carried a hint of playfulness—this was the probing before the tiger-devouring-the-fool act.

dialogue.content: Gui Xu let out a hoarse laugh that echoed across the empty battlefield, startling a flock of crows. "Bold! This one likes speaking with clever people." He waved his hand, and a light screen unfurled in mid-air, displaying maps of the three major sects covered in countless red dots.

text.content: "See these red dots?" Gui Xu's voice carried a hint of pride. "Each one is a hidden piece our Demonic Path has planted within the three major sects over ten thousand years. Three hundred seventy-two in Tianqing Sect, five hundred nine in Xuanwu Sect, six hundred twenty-one in White Tiger Sect. This one can have them act at any moment."

dialogue.content: Chen Ji gazed at the densely packed red dots, a gleam flickering in his eyes. He finally understood why the Demonic Path could always precisely find weak points in every sect war—those so-called 'surprise attacks' were merely the result of insiders working in concert with outsiders. "Excellent scheming. Ten thousand years of布局, truly patient."

text.content: Gui Xu retracted the light screen and clasped his hands behind his back, ambition blazing in his emerald pupils. "This one comes today not to threaten you, but to tell you a truth." He paused, his voice suddenly dropping low. "The Three Realms are merely a cage made by the Heavenly Dao. And our Demonic Path seeks to break this cage and establish a Fourth Realm."

dialogue.content: Ye Qing drew a sharp breath. Though she was the Holy Sect's Saintess, she had never heard of the Demonic Path possessing such ambition. She unconsciously glanced at Chen Ji, only to find his expression still unruffled, as if what Gui Xu had revealed was not some earth-shattering secret, but merely that today's weather was pleasant.

text.content: "The Heavenly Dao treats all living beings as ants, casually manipulating their fates." Gui Xu stepped forward, his black robe billowing in the wind. "And the Tianji Record in your hands was originally a tool the Heavenly Dao used to control prophets. It's just that... it seems to have chosen a restless master."

dialogue.content: Hearing this, a cold smile finally curved Chen Ji's lips. "Restless? This one prefers to call it 'having one's own mind.'" He lifted his gaze to meet Gui Xu's directly. "Speak. What do you want this one to do? Help you deal with the Heavenly Dao? Don't tell me your Demonic Path has no backup plan."

text.content: Gui Xu seemed utterly unconcerned by Chen Ji's attitude, even showing a hint of appreciation. "This one wants you to replace the Heavenly Dao and become the new Will of Heaven." His voice carried seduction. "And in exchange, the Demonic Path will gain independent survival rights—the Fourth Realm will forever remain outside your jurisdiction."

The conditions offered were extremely tempting, yet riddled with traps at every turn. Chen Ji coldly smirked in his heart: Help you replace the Heavenly Dao, you must think I'm a fool? But on the surface, he maintained the caution befitting atrash disciple, asking in a low voice, "Replace the Heavenly Dao? Do you know what the price is?"

dialogue.content: Gui Xu gave Chen Ji a meaningful look. "Price? Isn't your Tianji Record Fragment continuously repairing, bringing you closer to that position?" He twirled the skull令牌 in his hand. "This one can help you accelerate this process—for instance, by telling you the names of those hidden pieces."

choice.prompt: Demonic Path Commander Gui Xu offered an astonishing condition—help you replace the Heavenly Dao in exchange for the Demonic Path's independent survival rights. How many traps lurk within this deal?

choices.description: The Demonic Path's ambition is too great; the consequences of consorting with the tiger are hard to foresee. Better to slowly lay my own plans than to let the Demonic Path interfere.
choices.visible_cost: Lose support from Demonic Path insider intelligence
choices.visible_reward: Maintain independent status, avoid owing the Demonic Path any favors
choices.risk_hint: The Demonic Path may turn hostile

text.content: Chen Ji shook his head, his tone flat yet undisputable: "The terms are too harsh. This one does not take kindly to being used as a tool." His refusal was blunt and clean, leaving no room for illusion.

dialogue.content: Gui Xu's smile froze on his face, then transformed into an icy-cold laugh. "Bold! This one has existed for ten thousand years, yet this is the first time being refused in such a manner." He narrowed his emerald-green eyes, "Young Friend Chen, are you certain you won't reconsider?"

choices.description: Cooperation is possible, but with boundaries. Utilize the intelligence from the Demonic Path's hidden agents, but under no circumstances reveal the secrets of the Tianji Record.
choices.visible_cost: May need to share part of the benefits
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the list of Demonic Path's hidden agents and intelligence support
choices.risk_hint: Intelligence exchange may lead to identity exposure

text.content: Chen Ji pondered for a moment, revealing a meaningful smile. "Cooperation is possible, but I have conditions." His tone was neither servile nor overbearing, "The list of hidden agents must be handed to me, but you are forbidden from inquiring about the Tianji Record."

dialogue.content: Gui Xu seemed to have anticipated this condition, nodding in agreement: "Done. However, I must remind you - after thirty days, if you betray me, the Demonic Path will assist the Heavenly Way in completing the final purification." He glanced meaningfully at Chen Ji, "By then, don't blame me for not giving you this chance."

choices.description: 表面上 accept cooperation, but actually turn the tables. Use the Demonic Path's hidden agent network to set up a counter-layout, making the Demonic Path become one's own chess piece.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the list of hidden agents while also grasping leverage over the Demonic Path
choices.risk_hint: If exposed, will completely offend the Demonic Path

text.content: A subtle gleam flickered in Chen Ji's eyes, quickly replaced by an expression of "overwhelmed by gratitude." "I am honored by the Commander's regard. This one is willing to serve." He lowered his gaze, fully embodying the posture of a "trash攀上高枝" (a nobody grasping at a higher branch).

dialogue.content: Gui Xu nodded with satisfaction, drawing a black token from his sleeve and tossing it to Chen Ji. "This is the Demonic Path Outer Envoy Token. Hidden agents recognize this token as they would recognize me." He turned to leave but paused, "By the way, this one may know some clues about your sister's reincarnation location."

text.content: Chen Ling's form dissolved like morning mist, with faint traces of spiritual energy lingering in the air. Her final words still echoed in his ears - "Brother, I'll wait for you to find her." The jade slip lay quietly in his palm, carrying the last trace of warmth.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji tucked the jade slip into his sleeve, his voice low yet carrying undeniable resolve: "She will be fine. This one has sworn an oath." His gaze chilled as he looked toward where Gui Xu had departed, "And you - you'd best pray you're not an obstacle to her reincarnation."

text.content: After Gui Xu left, Ye Qing finally couldn't hold back: "Chen Ji, have you lost your mind? That's the Demonic Path Commander!" Her voice carried urgency, "Allying with him is no different than making a pact with the tiger!"

dialogue.content: Chen Ji didn't answer her question, instead asking something seemingly unrelated: "Ye Qing, what method does the Holy Sect use to control you?" Ye Qing's expression shifted slightly. After a moment of silence, she said: "Soul contract... if I defy the Holy Sect's orders, my soul scatters."

text.content: Chen Ji nodded, a cold smirk forming at the corner of his mouth. "Gui Xu gave you a thirty-day deadline, which means the soul contract's constraint is not unbreakable." He turned to look at Ye Qing, his gaze carrying a hint of seriousness, "During these thirty days, I want you to do one thing - find out the true purpose of the 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key'."

dialogue.content: Ye Qing froze, then quickly understood: "You're saying... your sister's identity is connected to the key to breaking the soul contract?" Her breath quickened, a glimmer of hope flashing in her eyes, "If that's truly the case, I'm willing to take this gamble!"

text.content: Chen Ji didn't elaborate further. Instead, he took out the Tianji Record Fragment and infused it with spiritual energy. Master Mo's voice rang in his mind: "Young man, are you certain about using the foresight ability now? Your Heavenly Fate is already below thirty."

dialogue.content: "Thirty is enough." Chen Ji replied calmly, "This one wants to see - what will truly happen after thirty days." The runes on the fragment began to flow, and the world before Chen Ji's eyes once again became hazy. The gears of fate began to turn.

choice.prompt: The Tianji Record prophecy emerged: after thirty days, the Tianqing Sect's destruction was imminent. However, an unexpected variable appeared in the foresight vision -

choices.description: Consume additional Heavenly Fate to view the complete vision of the prophecy, including the source of variables. This may reveal more of the Tianji Record's abilities.
choices.visible_reward: Clearly see the source of variables, obtain key intelligence
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate further decreases, may trigger unknown consequences

text.content: Chen Ji clenched his teeth and injected spiritual energy again. The prophetic vision gradually became clearer—the variable was actually someone from within the Tianqing Sect. In the vision, a familiar figure stood beside Ling Yuan, turning to Chen Ji with a smug smile.
The moment Chen Ji recognized the face, his pupils contracted sharply. It was someone he once trusted most—one of the Inner Disciple Senior Fellows of the Tianqing Sect, Su Qingyao.

choices.description: Preserve Heavenly Fate, only viewing key information. Although the variable was unexpected, he had long prepared countermeasures against insiders.
choices.visible_reward: Preserve Heavenly Fate, leaving room for future strategic布局
choices.risk_hint: May Have Underestimated the Insider's Harm

text.content: Chen Ji withdrew his spiritual energy. Though the prophetic vision was incomplete, the key information was already in his hands: there would indeed be a turning point in thirty days, but it wasn't irreversible. A cold smile curled at the corner of his mouth, 'An insider? Interesting.'

dialogue.content: Ye Qing watched Chen Ji's cold smile and shivered inexplicably. She suddenly realized this seemingly worthless man had likely already laid an intricate web in the shadows. And she—perhaps was just another piece on his chessboard.

choices.description: Not relying on prophecy, using one's own strategy to deduce the source of variables. Consumes energy but does not affect Heavenly Fate.
choices.visible_cost: Energy Consumption, May Affect Short-term Combat Power
choices.visible_reward: Do Not Consume Heavenly Fate, Train One's Own Abilities

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes and began rapid deduction. Those who could access the sect's core secrets were limited to a few individuals. Su Qingyao? Ling Yuan? Or... His eyes snapped open, 'So that's how it is.'

Chen Ji looked at Ye Qing, his gaze carrying a hint of playfulness: 'Among the Demonic Path's hidden agents, is there a codename called 'Qingluan'?' Ye Qing's expression slightly changed: 'That's the head of the Holy Sect's hidden agent implanted in the Tianqing Sect... How do you know?'

Ye Qing was shaken to her core by this question. She stared at Chen Ji fixedly, her voice trembling: 'How... how do you know? Even this Saintess only learned of 'Qingluan's' existence by accident...' Her breathing quickened, realizing this seemingly worthless disciple was far more profound and unfathomable than she had imagined.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji offered no answer, merely smiling faintly: 'This One has said, the list of Demonic Path's hidden agents belongs to me.' His gaze swept past Ye Qing toward the distant Tianqing Sect, 'Thirty days... that's enough.'

text.content: At this moment, a violent spiritual energy fluctuation suddenly erupted from the direction of Tianqing Sect. The formation eye of the mountain protection array was activated from within, brilliant cyan light shooting toward the heavens, then rapidly dimming—someone was destroying the formation!

dialogue.content: Ye Qing's expression drastically changed: 'No good! This is the signal for the Demonic Path's hidden agents to act!' She looked at Chen Ji, 'Guixu was right—his hidden agents are everywhere among the three major sects. Now it seems, the thirty-day deadline was merely to see how you would choose—if you refuse, they will coordinate with Heaven's mechanisms to act!'

text.content: Chen Ji calmly straightened his robe, a playful curve forming at the corner of his mouth. 'I haven't decided whether to agree yet, but you're already making decisions for me?' His tone carried a hint of mockery. 'You think I can't see through Guixu's little schemes?'

He turned to gaze toward the Tianqing Sect, a cold glint flickering in his eyes. 'However, since the hidden piece has already moved, I might as well... go with the flow.' His voice was low and dangerous. 'Let the Demonic Path and Heavenly Dao fight it out first. This one will simply watch from the mountain top.'

dialogue.content: Ye Qing's eyes widened: 'Are you saying... you don't plan to save the Tianqing Sect?' Chen Ji shook his head, a calculating gleam in his gaze: 'Save? Of course I'll save. But how I save, and who I save, is for me to decide.'

choice.prompt: The hidden agent within the Tianqing Sect has been activated, and the Sect's protective mountain formation trembles precariously. As the inheritor of the Tianji Record, how will Chen Ji make his choice?

choices.description: Su Qingyao is currently the only Inner Disciple who trusts him. Her life and death are crucial to the subsequent布局. He would rather expose his strength than fail to save her.
choices.visible_cost: Expose a portion of his strength and attract attention
choices.visible_reward: Su Qingyao's favorability increases significantly, gaining access to Inner Sect intelligence channels
choices.risk_hint: May be discovered by Ling Yuan's watchful eye

text.content: Chen Ji's figure flashed, darting directly toward the Tianqing Sect. Ye Qing called out behind him: 'Are you mad! That's a battlefield where the Demonic Path and Heavenly Dao are playing their game!' Chen Ji didn't look back: 'This one never gambles on a game without certainty.'

dialogue.content: He silently recited in his heart: Su Qingyao, if you truly are that variable, let me see if you're worth the risk this one is taking.

choices.text: Obtain the hidden agent list first
choices.description: Seizing the Demonic Path's hidden agent list during the chaos is the top priority. Su Qingyao's safety depends on her own choices.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the complete hidden agent list, fully grasping the initiative
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao may be in danger during this period

text.content: Chen Ji did not fly toward the Sect. Instead, he turned and rushed toward the location where Guixu had left the black token. The token radiated gentle warmth, guiding him toward a secluded valley.

Ye Qing followed closely behind and immediately understood Chen Ji's intention: 'You're going to the place the token is pointing to?' Chen Ji nodded: 'Since Guixu gave me this token, it means the hidden agents' contact point is nearby. While they're busy dealing with the Tianqing Sect, this one might as well take advantage of the situation.'

choices.text: Lure the snake out of its hole
choices.description: Instead of acting directly, use his 'waste' persona to lure out the masterminds behind the scenes. Let them believe their plan is succeeding and lower their guard.
choices.visible_reward: Identify all internal traitors and eliminate them in one fell swoop
choices.risk_hint: The Sect may suffer heavy losses

text.content: Chen Ji stopped in his tracks and turned to look at Ye Qing: 'Tell me, who do the hidden agents most want to kill?' Ye Qing froze, then came to a realization: '...You. The inheritor of the Tianji Record is their primary target.'

A cold smile curved Chen Ji's lips: 'Then this one will give them this opportunity.' He deliberately released a trace of the Tianji Record's aura, then sped away in the opposite direction. As expected, several black shadows darted out from the darkness, closely in pursuit.

Ye Qing watched Chen Ji's departing back, her heart filled with mixed emotions. This man always finds the optimal solution in the most desperate situations, yet never allows others to predict his next move. She gritted her teeth and followed—after all, he had already chosen to stand against the Demonic Path.

However, shortly after Chen Ji left, a figure materialized from the Void. The person wore Tianqing Sect Inner Sect elder robes, with handsome features and a teasing smile at the corner of his mouth. It was Ling Yuan's confidant—Outer Court Senior Elder Zhou. He gazed at the direction of Chen Ji's departure and sneered: "Useless trash? Hmph... hiding deep enough."

dialogue.content: Just then, an aged voice came from behind him: "Elder Zhou, you've worked hard." Ling Yuan's figure emerged from the darkness, his eyes gleaming with greed: "The aura of the Tianji Record... even more concentrated than this old man anticipated. Chen Ji, Chen Ji, did you think this old man didn't know your hidden trump card?"

text.content: Ling Yuan stood with hands clasped behind his back, watching the Spiritual Energy shooting up towards the Tianqing Sect. A cold smile curled his lips. "The Demonic Path wants to strike in the chaos? The Heavenly Dao wants to use a blade to kill?" He turned to Elder Zhou: "Transmit the order—the plan moves up. Let Chen Ji see what it truly means to be—the oriole behind the mantis."

dialogue.content: At the same time, Chen Ji seemed to sense something, his footsteps pausing slightly. He turned to gaze towards the Tianqing Sect, a trace of solemnity flickering in his eyes: "Ling Yuan... you old fox, you finally couldn't hold back?" His voice was low and dangerous: "This one has been waiting for you. Waiting for a very long time."
